description: A New York jury awarded detransitioner Fox Varian $2 million against the doctors who approved and performed her double mastectomy when she was 16.
shortAnswer: A young woman, just 16 at the time of her surgery, won a $2 million verdict against the doctors who pushed her into a double mastectomy as part of gender-transition care. This is the first time a jury has held medical professionals accountable in a detransitioner malpractice trial.

faq.q: What claims can parents bring if their child was harmed by gender-transition care?
faq.a: If your child has suffered from similar medical negligence, you have options. We can pursue claims based on failure to obtain informed consent, deviation from care standards, or even products liability if devices or drugs were involved.
